sentences.en: The good team spirit in the work group is valued positively.
sentences.zh: 1. 工作小组中积极向上的团队精神受到肯定。

sentences.en: When we think positively, we find solutions everywhere.
sentences.zh: 2. 当我们乐观思考时，我们会发现解决方案无处不在。

sentences.en: I look positively on working with them.
sentences.zh: 3. 我对与他们合作持肯定态度。

senses.zh: 极其;绝对地;十分肯定地;坚定地
